description: Product photos framed for each marketplace: a near-white border is trimmed, then the product is centred on the marketplace’s canvas at its usual fill. Amazon 2000×2000 (85%), eBay 1600×1600 (80%), Etsy 2000×1600 (75%), Shopify 2048×2048 (80%), Instagram Shop 1080×1350 (75%), Google Shopping 1200×1200 (80%). Works best with products shot on white; the photo’s own background is kept (removing it needs Cutout on one.design). Saved next to the originals as name-<marketplace>.jpg. [Pro tool.]

background.description: "white" (pure white, what most marketplaces want for the main image) or a hex colour.

files.description: Image files or folders (a folder means the images in it). ~ is your home folder.

fill_percent.description: How much of the frame the product fills along its limiting side, the same for every marketplace. Default: each marketplace’s own.

output_dir.description: Folder to save results in. Default: next to each original. Originals are never overwritten.

trim.description: Trim the near-white border round the product first.
